message:
The literary inspiration for Tink's "costume" is the pulp horror fiction of H. P. Lovecraft. A few days too late, I stumbled across this fine pop-surrealist Lovecraftian painting

![Cthulhu trick-or-treats behind a Lovecraft mask](/weblog/assets/pooch_cthulhu.jpg)

by the artist Pooch at the [Roq La Rue Gallery site](http://roqlarue.com/frame/frm-opener.html).
